titleEn: Lights Come On, One by One

pages.text: At sunset, each boat lit a little lamp. More and more lights filled the dark river.
Bung wiped a place at the bow. "Let us sit here together tonight, Ddori."
Mom asked Bung to wash bowls. Bung glanced at the pile. "Later."
Bung hid among nets to play with Ddori. The sun sank at the river's end.
The sky grew dim. Not one bowl was washed.
A light came on across the water. Bung was washing bowls at the bucket.
Boat lights came on one by one. Bung still held many bowls. Ddori waited at the bow. Mom watched Ddori.
Mom took the last bowl. "What comes first tomorrow?"
Next day, Bung washed all the bowls before sunset. Soaking had made the hands wrinkly.
Bung and Ddori sat side by side at the bow. Boat lights came on, one by one.
